--- file:///.src/mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Effect, Option, pipe } from "effect"
import * as E from "effect/Effect"
import * as O from "effect/Option"
import { some as optionSome } from "effect/Option"

declare const lookup: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const lookupOrFail: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | Cause.TimeoutError>

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()
const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

// MUST TRIGGER: the example from the issue, Effect.map(Option.some) then catchTag into Option.none()
export const issueExample = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.asSome then catchTag into Effect.succeedNone
export const asSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: eta-expanded Option.some mapper
export const etaExpanded = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: single-return block body mapper
export const blockMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => {
    return Option.some(value)
  }),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchTag(Effect.asSome(lookup), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome)
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),

  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Effect, Option, pipe } from "effect"
import * as E from "effect/Effect"
import * as O from "effect/Option"
import { some as optionSome } from "effect/Option"

declare const lookup: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const lookupOrFail: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | Cause.TimeoutError>

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()
const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

// MUST TRIGGER: the example from the issue, Effect.map(Option.some) then catchTag into Option.none()
export const issueExample = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(
    Effect.map(Option.some),
    Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
  )

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.asSome then catchTag into Effect.succeedNone
export const asSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: eta-expanded Option.some mapper
export const etaExpanded = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: single-return block body mapper
export const blockMapper = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchTag(Effect.asSome(lookup), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome)
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup

  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Effect, Option, pipe } from "effect"
import * as E from "effect/Effect"
import * as O from "effect/Option"
import { some as optionSome } from "effect/Option"

declare const lookup: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const lookupOrFail: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | Cause.TimeoutError>

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()
const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

// MUST TRIGGER: the example from the issue, Effect.map(Option.some) then catchTag into Option.none()
export const issueExample = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(
    Effect.map(Option.some),
    Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
  )

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.asSome then catchTag into Effect.succeedNone
export const asSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: eta-expanded Option.some mapper
export const etaExpanded = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: single-return block body mapper
export const blockMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => {
    return Option.some(value)
  }),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(Effect.tap(value => Effect.log(value)), Effect.catchNoSuchElement, Effect.map(Option.isSome))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchTag(Effect.asSome(lookup), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome)
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package

  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

--- file:///.src/mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Effect, Option, pipe } from "effect"
import * as E from "effect/Effect"
import * as O from "effect/Option"
import { some as optionSome } from "effect/Option"

declare const lookup: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const lookupOrFail: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | Cause.TimeoutError>

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()
const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

// MUST TRIGGER: the example from the issue, Effect.map(Option.some) then catchTag into Option.none()
export const issueExample = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(
    Effect.map(Option.some),
    Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
  )

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.asSome then catchTag into Effect.succeedNone
export const asSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: eta-expanded Option.some mapper
export const etaExpanded = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: single-return block body mapper
export const blockMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => {
    return Option.some(value)
  }),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchNoSuchElement(lookup)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome)
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Effect, Option, pipe } from "effect"
import * as E from "effect/Effect"
import * as O from "effect/Option"
import { some as optionSome } from "effect/Option"

declare const lookup: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const lookupOrFail: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | Cause.TimeoutError>

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()
const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

// MUST TRIGGER: the example from the issue, Effect.map(Option.some) then catchTag into Option.none()
export const issueExample = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(
    Effect.map(Option.some),
    Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
  )

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.asSome then catchTag into Effect.succeedNone
export const asSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: eta-expanded Option.some mapper
export const etaExpanded = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: single-return block body mapper
export const blockMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => {
    return Option.some(value)
  }),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchTag(Effect.asSome(lookup), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: other errors are preserved, catchNoSuchElement only removes NoSuchElementError
export const otherErrorsKept = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: NoSuchElementError is added by an earlier step of the same flow
export const introducedByHead = Effect.succeed([1, 2, 3]).pipe(
  Effect.head,
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair sits between other steps, which stay in place
export const surroundedBySteps = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe(...) function form with aliased module namespaces
export const aliasedModules = pipe(
  lookup,
  E.map(O.some),
  E.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => E.succeed(O.none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: named import of Option.some
export const namedSome = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(optionSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first calls
export const dataFirstAsSome = Effect.catchTag(Effect.asSome(lookup), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first outer catchTag around a pipeable inner step
export const mixedForms = Effect.catchTag(lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome), "NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
export const mixedFormsMap = Effect.catchTag(
  lookup.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  "NoSuchElementError",
  () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
)

// MUST TRIGGER: the pair spans two chained .pipe(...) calls
export const crossPipe = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome)
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.fn pipeline steps
export const effectFn = Effect.fn(
  function*(id: string) {
    return yield* findUser(id)
  },
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: each occurrence in the same flow is reported
export const repeated = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone), Effect.flatMap(Effect.fromOption), Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already uses the dedicated combinator
export const alreadyCatchNoSuchElement = lookup.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: reverse order is not equivalent, asSome wraps the recovered None into Some(None)
export const reverseOrder = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone),
  Effect.asSome
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the steps are not adjacent
export const nonAdjacent = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a step separates the pair across the pipe boundary
export const separatedAcrossPipes = lookup
  .pipe(Effect.asSome, Effect.tap((value) => Effect.log(value)))
  .pipe(Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag without the Option.some wrapping step
export const catchOnly = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed("fallback"))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: wrapping step without the catchTag
export const asSomeOnly = lookup.pipe(Effect.asSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: TimeoutError is a different tag, catchNoSuchElement does not apply
export const timeoutTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper transforms the value before wrapping it
export const transformedMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value.length)),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

const localSome = <A>(value: A): Option.Option<A> => Option.some(value)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper does not resolve to Effect's Option.some
export const localSomeMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(localSome),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the mapper wraps in Option.fromNullishOr, not Option.some
export const fromNullishOrMapper = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.fromNullishOr),
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the tag argument is not a string literal
const tag = "NoSuchElementError" as const
export const nonLiteralTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(tag, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the array tag form of catchTag
export const arrayTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag(["NoSuchElementError"], () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTag with an orElse handler for the remaining errors
export const withOrElse = lookupOrFail.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone, () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments may widen the result type on purpose
export const explicitTypeArguments = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag<"NoSuchElementError", Cause.NoSuchElementError, Option.Option<string>, never, never>(
    "NoSuchElementError",
    () => Effect.succeedNone
  )
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchTags is a different API
export const catchTags = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTags({ NoSuchElementError: () => Effect.succeedNone })
)

const fake = {
  asSome: <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self.pipe(Effect.map(Option.some)),
  catchTag: (_tag: "NoSuchElementError", _f: () => Effect.Effect<Option.Option<never>>) =>
  <A, Err, R>(self: Effect.Effect<A, Err, R>) => self
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: lookalike APIs that are not from the effect package
export const lookalikeAsSome = lookup.pipe(
  fake.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
export const lookalikeCatchTag = lookup.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  fake.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
